Container.Name: highsea-nvidia
Container.Overview:
highsea finds, downloads and organises your films, with their subtitles, and serves them to your own apps. One self-hosted server in place of Radarr, Prowlarr, qBittorrent and Bazarr.
This template is for NVIDIA graphics and needs the Nvidia-Driver plugin. Without NVIDIA, use highsea.
Put downloads and the library on one share (the data path), so imports hardlink instead of copying. Apps on your network find highsea by its broadcast on 7368/udp, and by mDNS through Unraid's own avahi (the D-Bus path), in bridge mode too.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: radarr prowlarr qbittorrent bazarr torrent subtitles movies films
Container.Requires: The Nvidia-Driver plugin from Apps, and an NVIDIA card. Without NVIDIA, install highsea instead.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: The admin, the API and the apps' address.

Config.Name: Torrents (TCP)
Config.Description: The torrent engine's listening port. Change both sides together, and forward it on your router for incoming peers.

Config.Name: Torrents (UDP)
Config.Description: The same port, for uTP and the DHT.

Config.Name: Discovery
Config.Description: Apps on your network find the server by this broadcast.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: The database, settings, logs and backups.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: One share for downloads and the library, so imports hardlink. Setup suggests /data/downloads and /data/media/movies.

Config.Name: NVIDIA cards
Config.Description: all, or one card's UUID from nvidia-smi -L.

Config.Name: NVIDIA capabilities
Config.Description: What the container gets from the driver: video is the encoder and decoder.

Config.Name: D-Bus
Config.Description: Unraid's system bus, so highsea can publish itself over mDNS through Unraid's avahi.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user that owns your files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group that owns your files.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: Optional. The https:// address you reach highsea at from outside, if you serve it through a reverse proxy.
